name: getUsage
description: Read MCP tool call usage. Local-first: usage is unlimited, this status check never consumes anything.

name: listDesigns
description: Start here. List the local Sheet designs and canonical editor URLs.

name: getWebDocument
description: Read a web-native design document: DOM nodes and roots, authored stylesheets and rules with media/container/supports conditions, components, and instances with bindings and overrides. Returns the revision for optimistic concurrency. This is authored source of truth; computed styles are never stored.

name: getWebHTML
description: Serialize a web-native document to HTML. Direct serialization of the authored DOM; no translation layer.

name: getWebCSS
description: Serialize a web-native document to authored CSS stylesheets. Direct serialization of the authored rules in cascade order; computed values never appear.

name: applyWebTransaction
description: Mutate a web-native document with one validated WebTransaction: the same operation vocabulary, validation, undo inverses, revision compare-and-swap, history, and realtime path the editor uses. Operations: node.insert/node.patch/node.move/node.delete, stylesheet.insert/stylesheet.patch/stylesheet.delete, rule.insert/rule.patch/rule.move/rule.delete, component.define/component.delete, instance.create/instance.delete/instance.setOverride/instance.clearOverride. Page 1 (the unnamed first page) starts empty and has no edge: create each frame as a top-level node (parentId null) with position:absolute, left, top, width and height, and set frames side by side; do not wrap a design in one page-sized root. To resize a named page, node.patch its root element width and height, for example 1440px by 2400px. Never widen or resize a page to fit several designs: every screen or variant (light and dark, option A and B, mobile and desktop) goes in its own page via createPage, then insert into it with parentId = that pageId. Rules: patching a bound instance node directly is rejected (use instance.setOverride with text, attributes, or --custom-properties); template edits propagate to instances automatically; component CSS reaches instances through the normal cascade. Stale expectedRevision returns applied:false with reason stale instead of overwriting. Returns only applied, revision and changedNodeIds; pass verbose: true for the full document. Pass dryRun: true to validate without saving: every invalid operation is reported in one pass. stylesheet.insert accepts rules without ruleOrder (derived from each rule order field); if given, ruleOrder must list every rule id once. Send a large theme stylesheet in its own transaction before the nodes.

draftId.description: Branch target; omit for Main. Draft writes require an active branch.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from getWebDocument; the write fails stale when it moved.

id.description: Stable idempotency id; retries reuse it.

operations.description: WebOperations validated exactly like editor transactions.

transaction.description: One atomic batch; applied fully or not at all.

dryRun.description: Validate only: check every operation (and apply it in memory against Main) without saving. Reports all problems at once.

verbose.description: Also return the full updated document. Off by default: the response is just applied, revision and changedNodeIds.

name: getWebScreenshot
description: Render a real PNG of a web-native document with the same standalone HTML/CSS serialization the editor materializes. Rendered by the open Sheet app window, so the app must be running; if it is not, the call fails with a message saying so. Call this after meaningful edits to verify the visual result. Read-only: revisions, history, and the document are untouched.

rootId.description: Web node id to capture; omit for the whole document.

name: exportDesign
description: Export a design. format "html" returns the complete self-contained page (all DOM and CSS in one file, ready to save as .html); "png"/"jpg" return a rendered image as base64; "json" returns the authored web document. The result carries filename, mimeType, encoding ("utf8" or "base64") and data.

format.description: html: one complete self-contained page (DOM + all CSS). png/jpg: rendered image. json: the authored web document.

rootId.description: png/jpg only: web node id to capture; omit for the whole document.

width.description: png/jpg only: viewport width in px.

name: createDesign
description: Create a new empty Canvas design.

name: renameDesign
description: Rename a design.

name: deleteDesign
description: Archive a design after explicit confirmation. It leaves every list; the owner restores it, or deletes it for good, from the archive in the app.

name: listBranches
description: List branches. Branch state is separate from the canvas package.

name: createBranch
description: Create an isolated app-level branch from current Main.

name: proposeBranch
description: Freeze an active branch for review.

name: reopenBranch
description: Return a proposed branch to editable status.

name: compareBranch
description: Compare a branch with Main using field-level semantic merge.

name: applyBranch
description: Apply a branch to Main. Supply a main or draft choice for every reported conflict.

name: closeBranch
description: Close an active or proposed branch without applying it.

name: listVersions
description: List version history for Main or one branch.

name: searchIcons
description: Search the supported icon libraries (hugeicons, lucide) by name. Omit library to search all. Use the returned library and name with insertIcon.

name: insertIcon
description: Insert a library icon as an editable svg node (tagged data-icon-library / data-icon-name). Color sets the svg color style, size sets width and height, strokeWidth sets the outline weight. Restyle later with styleIcon. Pass parentId to put it in a frame. With no parentId on a named page it goes in the page root; on Page 1 it goes in the only top-level frame, sits top level when there is none, and is refused when there are several, so name the frame.

parentId.description: Element to insert into; defaults to the page root

pageId.description: Page to insert into (the pageId from createPage or listPages); defaults to the first page. Ignored when parentId is given. The first page, Page 1, starts empty and has no edge: with nothing on it and no parentId the node becomes a top-level frame, so give it position:absolute with left, top, width and height.

color.description: Any CSS color; icons draw in currentColor

name: styleIcon
description: Restyle an icon inserted with insertIcon: color, size (px) and strokeWidth in one atomic edit. Only the fields you pass change.

nodeId.description: The icon svg node id returned by insertIcon

color.description: Any CSS color; icons draw in currentColor

name: listPages
description: List a design's pages. Page 1 (pageId null) is always listed first: it starts empty, has no edge, and holds top-level frames. Every other page is isolated, with its own layers. pageId is the page root node id (use it as parentId, and as rootId for getWebScreenshot or exportDesign); null is the original unnamed page.

name: createPage
description: Add a page: a new isolated canvas with its own layers, size and background, separate from every other page. Add a page only when the user asks for separate pages. By default design on Page 1, which starts empty and has no edge, with each screen or variant as its own top-level frame set side by side (applyWebTransaction node.insert with parentId null, position absolute, left, top, width, height). A page made here is a bounded, painted artboard. Returns pageId, the page root node id. Put content in it by passing pageId to insertIcon/insertShader, or pageId as parentId in applyWebTransaction node.insert. Rename a page by node.patch on its data-sheet-page attribute; delete one with node.delete on its pageId.

name.description: Page name; defaults to the next "Page N"

name: listFramePresets
description: List the frame sizes the editor offers when you pick the Frame tool, grouped as Phone, Tablet, Desktop, Presentation, Smartwatch, Paper and Social media, each with width and height in px. Pass a preset name to createFrame to make a frame of exactly that size.

name: createFrame
description: Add a frame to a page: a white, free-positioned box the person can move, resize and rename, built exactly as the editor's Frame tool builds one. Give a preset name from listFramePresets (for example "iPhone 16" or "MacBook Air") or a width and height. With no left and top it goes one gap to the right of the page's other top-level frames, so several calls set frames side by side. Returns nodeId; build the design inside it by passing nodeId as parentId in applyWebTransaction, insertIcon or insertShader.

preset.description: A name from listFramePresets, matched ignoring case

width.description: Width in px; used when there is no preset

height.description: Height in px; used when there is no preset

name.description: Layer name; defaults to the preset name, or "Frame"

pageId.description: Page to insert into (the pageId from createPage or listPages); defaults to the first page. Ignored when parentId is given. The first page, Page 1, starts empty and has no edge: with nothing on it and no parentId the node becomes a top-level frame, so give it position:absolute with left, top, width and height.

left.description: Left edge in px on the page

top.description: Top edge in px on the page

name: listShaders
description: List the available Paper shaders with their params: type, range or options, and default. Use the names and params with insertShader and styleShader.

name: insertShader
description: Insert a Paper shader (animated WebGL gradient or texture) as an editable box, tagged data-shader / data-shader-params. Width and height are px; params tune the shader. Restyle later with styleShader. Renders in the editor and preview only; exported HTML keeps the box and its params but does not draw the shader. With no parentId the shader is its own free-positioned object on the page, placed beside the other top-level objects, so the person can move and resize it like a frame; give left and top to place it yourself. With a parentId it goes inside that element.

shader.description: mesh-gradient: Flowing color spots moving along distinct trajectories with organic distortion. | static-mesh-gradient: Multi-point mesh gradient with two-direction warping. Renders one still frame. | swirl: Animated bands of color twisting into spirals, arcs and circular flows. | grain-gradient: Multi-color gradient with noise-textured distortion in seven abstract forms. | static-radial-gradient: A radial gradient with a movable focal point, falloff and optional grain. Renders one still frame. | simplex-noise: A soft, drifting field of color bands cut from simplex noise. | warp: Checks, stripes or an edge, bent into swirling folds of color. | spiral: A single tapering spiral stroke over a flat color. | color-panels: Overlapping translucent panels of color that fan across the box. | neuro-noise: Glowing, branching filaments like a neural net, in three colors. | perlin-noise: Two-color cloud and marble patterns from layered Perlin noise. | voronoi: Glowing cells split by thin gaps, colored in steps. | waves: Rows of wavy lines in two colors. Renders one still frame. | dot-grid: A regular grid of circles, diamonds, squares or triangles. Renders one still frame. | dot-orbit: Dots circling in rings, colored in steps along their orbit. | god-rays: Beams of light fanning out from a glowing center, with bloom. | smoke-ring: A ring of drifting smoke, one or more colors on a flat background. | metaballs: Soft blobs of color that drift and merge. | pulsing-border: A glowing, pulsing outline that runs around the edge of the box.

parentId.description: Element to insert into; defaults to the page root

pageId.description: Page to insert into (the pageId from createPage or listPages); defaults to the first page. Ignored when parentId is given. The first page, Page 1, starts empty and has no edge: with nothing on it and no parentId the node becomes a top-level frame, so give it position:absolute with left, top, width and height.

left.description: Left edge in px, in its parent. Defaults to the next free spot beside the page's other top-level objects.

top.description: Top edge in px, in its parent. Defaults to level with the page's highest top-level object.

params.description: Shader params, for example { colors: ["#111","#f0f"], speed: 0.5, distortion: 0.8 }. Unknown keys are dropped and numbers are clamped to range; omitted keys keep their default.

name: styleShader
description: Change a shader inserted with insertShader: params (merged over the current ones), width and height in one atomic edit. Only the fields you pass change.

nodeId.description: The shader node id returned by insertShader

params.description: Shader params, for example { colors: ["#111","#f0f"], speed: 0.5, distortion: 0.8 }. Unknown keys are dropped and numbers are clamped to range; omitted keys keep their default.

name: listComments
description: Read the comments a person pinned to elements of a design. Each comment names the element it is about (nodeId, plus its current tag, text and id/class so you can find it without a second call), who wrote it, and whether it is resolved. Pass nodeId to read only the comments on one element; by default only open comments come back. Treat each comment as an instruction from the designer about that element: read the node with getWebDocument, make the change with applyWebTransaction, then call resolveComment. Comments sit beside the document and are never part of the HTML, CSS or JSON exports.

draftId.description: Read element details from this branch instead of Main

name: resolveComment
description: Mark a comment as resolved once you have acted on it, or pass resolved: false to reopen it. The designer sees the change in the editor straight away. Does not edit the design.

name: listAssets
description: List the local uploaded image assets.
